intent: Key public-network and DNS diagnostic hosts must NEVER be routed DIRECT by a generated self-hosted rule. This is an explicit routing policy, not a DNS-leak guarantee.
source_issue: blackmatrix7 ChinaMaxNoMedia_Domain included .browserleaks.com, which routed the public IP test to DIRECT
review: Review additions/deletions of protected domains and require an on-device comparison before enabling composite lists.
